items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
items.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.
